Ruth: Quick sync  social push for next Tue launch  need hero image (16:9), 1:1 crop, short loop MP4, two caption tracks (benchmark vs dev), UTMs, and 3 punchy replies per track. Can we lock assets by EOD?
Ezra: Uploading assets now to s3://redwood-marketing/launch/3187654321/ — filenames: hero_launch_v1.png, hero_1x1_v1.png, loop6s_v1.mp4. README with alt text included.
Cam: I'll draft two caption tracks. Variant Bench = latency/cost numbers; Variant Dev = integration + quickstart. Will make LinkedIn a bit longer.
Lina: Scheduling preference: LinkedIn 08:15 PT, X thread 09:15 PT. Pin webinar CTA in first X reply. I'll queue but keep on HOLD until Ruth signs off.
Ruth: CTA strings: primary "Get early access"; webinar pinned CTA = "Save your seat: redwood.ai/webinar?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=spark_launch_3187". HubSpot form -> list `spark_launch_3187`. Webhook to #leads-launch.
Ezra: Added tiny GIF fallback teaser_fallback.gif and a still for mobile. Also wrote alt text.
Cam: Draft micro-replies (benchmark):
- A1: "Which model/seq did you test on?"
- A2: "Nice numbers  can you share the config?"
- A3: "Want a short demo clip?"
Draft micro-replies (developer):
- B1: "How long to integrate end-to-end?"
- B2: "Any SDK samples?"
- B3: "Is hosted available?"
Ruth: Shorten replies for X (drop articles). Include one reply with webinar CTA. Keep hashtags minimal: #inference #redwood for LinkedIn.
SchedBot: Scheduling window reserved Tue 08:00-11:30 PT. No conflicts detected.
HubSpotBot: HubSpot form `hs_spark_3187` created and mapped to list `spark_launch_3187`. Tag rule `source:social_spark_3187` added. Webhook mapping to Slack `#leads-launch` verified.
Lina: I'll set replies to post at +7m / +18m / +30m after main thread and pin the first reply. Queue is ON HOLD pending Ruth's final copy.
Ruth: I'll review final copy and pinned reply by 4:30pm PT. If no blockers, approve at 5pm and Lina will release. Post-launch: monitor first 60m, seed retargeting audience if CTR <1.0% and notify SDRs.
Ezra: All assets uploaded and checksums in README.
Cam: Final copies posted here at 16:10 PT. Compressed for X-length.
Ruth: Approved  Lina please release and monitor. Thanks team :thumbsup:
